notes.title: 10% off release week!! And release date finalized!!
notes.notes:
Looks like there will be a 10% discount on the release week for this game!!

If you are looking forward to burning some spiders, make sure you do it with this [b]10% [/b]off in the release week itself. Yay!!!

Looking forward to your spider killing spree and pure fun and frustration time :D
